`caseyjr/` holds pins (spec §8 shape) of the live claims on caseyjr.org/blyg, captured by hand on 2026-11-18. `content_hash` is left out until the fetcher captures the real documents; `36ehyke3…v1` has its claim block only.

- `12cq260v…` v1 → v2 changes only the transclusion on line one. The claim block is identical, so the claim is verified as of v1. Its prose also restates the probability, which exercises the prose cross-check.
- `36ehyke3…` uses an unlabeled fence; `12cq260v…` uses `json`.
